name: release-planning
description: Plan releases across time: select release cadence (continuous / weekly / train / milestone-based), build Gantt with critical-path analysis, identify dependencies + constraints + resourcing, map WBS work packages + features to releases, buffer strategy, risk-adjusted scheduling, release tags + versioning (SemVer / CalVer), freeze windows, dress rehearsal. Hand-offs to estimation + WBS + DoD skills. Mermaid Gantt + dependency diagrams with optional PNG export.
